outcome: Wire promotion so that a Requirement can be evaluated and completed at all: today the only thing that can construct the proof completion requires has no caller outside a test.
non_goals: Do not complete a Requirement on the strength of an Increment succeeding
Do not construct the proof anywhere other than the promotion path that earns it
Do not claim a capability is exercised because the wiring exists

transitions.reason: the lifecycle work measured that the proof a completed Requirement requires can only be constructed through the promotion pipeline, and that the pipeline has zero non-test callers, so a running process cannot build the input at all. Evaluation and completion are therefore not merely unissued but impossible, and the product is explicit that an Increment succeeding must not complete a Requirement by itself
the task that measured this defect lands the first edges the rest build on
